fix_description: Import auth_system.py, create @require_auth decorator, apply to all /api/* routes. Issue JWT on PIN verification.

fix_description: Use subprocess.run with list args (shell=False). Never pass untrusted data into -c strings.
pattern: When I see command injection via string formatting, it means there's a security vulnerability. Fix: Use subprocess.run with list args (shell=False). Never pass untrusted data into -c strings.
prevention_rule: SECURITY RULE: Use subprocess.run with list args (shell=False). Never pass untrusted data into -c strings.

prevention_rule: SECURITY RULE: Protect with @require_auth and admin-only authorization.
